name: TRX Row
instructions: Hold the handles, lean back with arms extended, and pull your chest toward the anchor while squeezing your shoulder blades.

name: TRX Low Row
instructions: Walk your feet forward to increase the lean, then row with elbows close to your sides.

name: TRX Chest Press
instructions: Face away from the anchor, arms extended, lower your chest between the handles, then press back up.

name: TRX Chest Fly
instructions: From a standing plank facing away, open the arms in a wide arc, then squeeze back to center.

name: TRX Squat
instructions: Hold the handles lightly for balance, sit the hips back and down, then stand up through the heels.

name: TRX Jump Squat
instructions: Squat, then explode upward off the floor, landing softly with knees tracking over toes.

name: TRX Reverse Lunge
instructions: Hold the handles, step one foot back into a lunge, then drive through the front heel to stand.

name: TRX Crossing Balance Lunge
instructions: Step the rear foot behind and across the midline, keeping the front knee stacked over the ankle.

name: TRX Plank
instructions: Place both feet in the foot cradles, hold a rigid forearm or high plank, and brace the core.

name: TRX Mountain Climber
instructions: From a suspended plank, drive knees toward the chest in an alternating rhythm without sagging the hips.

name: TRX Atomic Push-Up
instructions: Feet in the cradles, perform a push-up, then tuck the knees toward the chest before extending back.

name: TRX Hip Press
instructions: Lie on your back with heels in the cradles and bridge the hips up, squeezing the glutes at the top.

name: TRX Hamstring Curl
instructions: From a hip bridge, curl the heels toward the glutes, then extend the legs without dropping the hips.

name: TRX Biceps Curl
instructions: Lean back holding the handles with palms up, curl the hands toward the temples, then extend with control.

name: TRX Triceps Press
instructions: Face away from the anchor, elbows high, extend the elbows to press the body up, then bend to lower.

name: TRX Y-Fly
instructions: Lean back and raise the arms into a Y overhead, keeping ribs down and shoulders packed.

name: TRX T-Fly
instructions: From a lean, open the arms out to a T, squeezing the rear delts, then return to start.

name: TRX Power Pull
instructions: Row with one hand while rotating the free arm toward the floor, then pull and rotate back up.

name: TRX Hip Drop
instructions: Stand side-on to the anchor, reach the top arm overhead, and drop the hip away, then pull back to tall.

name: TRX Crunch
instructions: Feet in the cradles in a plank, crunch the knees toward the elbows, then extend to a full plank.

name: TRX Pike
instructions: From a suspended plank, lift the hips into a pike while keeping the legs straight, then return.

name: TRX Overhead Squat
instructions: Press the handles overhead and squat as deep as mobility allows, keeping the torso tall.

name: TRX Single-Leg Squat
instructions: Hold the handles, extend one leg forward, and sit back into a pistol-style squat.

name: TRX Face Pull
instructions: Lean back and pull the handles toward the ears with high elbows, then extend with control.

name: TRX Chest Stretch
instructions: Face away, open one or both arms to the side, and gently rotate the chest through the stretch.
